name: @zeros/web
description: Cloudflare Pages hub for authentication handoff, app launch, and host-routed marketing delivery.

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788 --ip 127.0.0.1 --compatibility-date=2026-07-10 --kv SESSIONS --binding MARKETING_HOSTS=127.0.0.1,localhost
scripts.dev:app: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788 --ip 127.0.0.1 --compatibility-date=2026-07-10 --kv SESSIONS
scripts.check:session-worker: wrangler deploy --dry-run --env alpha --config session-worker/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env beta --config session-worker/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production --config session-worker/wrangler.jsonc
